129:.about-visual{position:relative}
130:.about-visual .frame{border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:4/5;position:relative;background:#161b22}
131:.about-visual .frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:saturate(1.05) contrast(1.05)}
132:.about-visual .frame::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 50%,rgba(13,17,23,.5));pointer-events:none}
133:.about-visual .badge{position:absolute;bottom:-22px;right:-22px;background:var(--gold);color:#111;border-radius:14px;padding:1.2rem 1.6rem;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
134:.about-visual .badge .num{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
135:.about-visual .badge .lbl{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.3rem}
